narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>five paise is zero point five rupee.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But zero point five rupee is fifty paise, ten times too much.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Five hundredths needs a zero in the tenths place.
